messages:
cassie: BankPOC blocked. They enable function_call + json_mode and are getting intermittent 429/500 and sometimes truncated JSON. Demo in ~18h, need quick triage.

ben: Which model/version and payload? Any gateway logs?

cassie: model=gpt-redwood-13b-v2, payload: {model:"gpt-redwood-13b-v2", json_mode:true, function_call:{name:"create_ticket"}, max_tokens:1200}. Client saw a retry then returned: 
`\{"ticket_id\":9876,\"status\":\"open\",` (cut).

maya: Sounds like stream cut mid-object. infra-bot - any rate-limit events?

infra-bot: gw-3 -> 429 at 2026-03-19T09:12:45Z. pool util: 94%.

sre-ops: Gateway reset at 2026-03-19T09:12:46Z (upstream close). Likely transport/truncation, not model hallucination.

ben: Quick fixes: 1) ask them to enable stream:true and assemble chunks client-side; 2) set structure.relaxed=true or json_mode=false to avoid strict parse; 3) reduce max_tokens or split response into two function calls.

maya: For types mismatch, include explicit types/examples in functions.parameters and an example response in the prompt. That usually fixes ticket_id being numeric vs string.

amy: If we need demo reliability we can spin a 24h dedicated instance. Cost estimate?

sre-ops: 24h small GPU = $650. Need manager approval for ad-hoc spend >$500. Can provision in ~30m once approved.

cassie: Action items: 1) I'll have customer enable stream + structure.relaxed and test; 2) maya will send a sample schema with type/examples; 3) amy will request approval if they want dedicated. I'll post results here. :thumbsup:
